nodes.statement: Let us write then $\exp \pi H(\Lambda, \lambda, x) = \sum A_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda) \lambda^\gamma x^u$ with $A_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda) \in R[[\Lambda]]$ and the indices $(\gamma, u) \in M(H) \subset M(\Gamma) \times M(f)$.

nodes.name: Coefficients J_{gamma,u}(Lambda)
nodes.statement:
We will also write 
\[
pr_0( \exp \pi H(\Lambda, \lambda, x) ) = \sum_{(\gamma, u) \in M_0(\Gamma) \times M_0(f)} J_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda) \tilde \pi^{-w_\Gamma(\gamma) -w(u)} \lambda^{-\gamma} x^{-u} =  \sum_{(\gamma, u) \in M_0(H)} \tilde{J}_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda) \tilde \pi^{-w_H(\gamma)} \lambda^{-\gamma} x^{-u}.
\]

nodes.name: Relation of J to A
nodes.statement: J_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda) = A_{-\gamma, -u}(\Lambda) \tilde \pi^{w_\Gamma(\gamma) + w(u)} = \tilde{J}_{\gamma,u} \tilde{\pi}^{ w_{\Gamma}(\gamma)+w(u) -w_H(\gamma,u) }
nodes.label: E: J's

nodes.name: Eigenvector eta
nodes.statement:
Define 
\begin{align} \eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) :&= \frac{1}{ J_{00}(\Lambda) } \text{pr}_0 \exp \pi H(\Lambda, \lambda, x) \notag \\
&= 1 + \sum_{\substack{ (\gamma, u) \in M_0(H)  \\  (\gamma, u) \not= (0,0)}} \frac{\tilde{J}_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda)}{J_{0,0}(\Lambda)} \tilde \pi^{-w_H(\gamma,u)} \lambda^{-\gamma} x^{-u}. 
\end{align}
nodes.statement_short: $\eta$ is the normalized projection $\mathrm{pr}_0\exp\pi H/J_{0,0}$; it will be the dual eigenvector.

nodes.name: Definition of eta
nodes.statement:
\eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) :&= \frac{1}{ J_{00}(\Lambda) } \text{pr}_0 \exp \pi H(\Lambda, \lambda, x) \notag \\
&= 1 + \sum_{\substack{ (\gamma, u) \in M_0(H)  \\  (\gamma, u) \not= (0,0)}} \frac{\tilde{J}_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda)}{J_{0,0}(\Lambda)} \tilde \pi^{-w_H(\gamma,u)} \lambda^{-\gamma} x^{-u}.
nodes.label: E: eigenvector

nodes.name: Convergence of J-ratios on the closed polydisk (from [MR2966711])
nodes.statement: In \cite{MR2966711}, it was shown that $J_{0,0}(\Lambda) / J_{0,0}(\Lambda^p)$ and $\tilde{J}_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda) / J_{0,0}(\Lambda)$ converge on the closed unit polydisk $| \Lambda | \leq 1$ for every $\Lambda$. Equivalently, $J_{0,0}(\Lambda) / J_{0,0}(\Lambda^p)$ and $ \tilde{J}_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda) / J_{0,0}(\Lambda)$ belong to $\c K_0$.
conclusions: $J_{0,0}(\Lambda) / J_{0,0}(\Lambda^p)$ and $\tilde{J}_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda) / J_{0,0}(\Lambda)$ converge on the closed unit polydisk $| \Lambda | \leq 1$ for every $\Lambda$

nodes.name: Ratios J_{gamma,u}/J_{0,0} lie in K_0
nodes.statement: The same holds as well for $ J_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda) / J_{0,0}(\Lambda)$ using (\ref{E: J's}), since $A_{-\gamma,-u}(\Lambda) \in R[[\Lambda]]$.
conclusions: The same holds as well for $ J_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda) / J_{0,0}(\Lambda)$

nodes.name: eta lies in D_0(W_0(K_0))
nodes.statement:
Since $J_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda) = A_{-\gamma, -u} \tilde \pi^{w_\Gamma(\gamma) + w(u)}$, we have
\[
\left| \sum_{\gamma \in M_0(\Gamma)} \frac{J_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda)}{ J_{0,0}(\Lambda)} \tilde \pi^{-w_\Gamma(\gamma)} \lambda^{-\gamma} \right| \leq |\tilde \pi |^{w(u)},
\]
and so $\eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) \in \c D_0(\c W_0(\c K_0)) \subset \c D( \c W(\c K_0))$.
conclusions: $\eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) \in \c D_0(\c W_0(\c K_0)) \subset \c D( \c W(\c K_0))$

nodes.name: Function F(Lambda)
nodes.statement: Set $\c F(\Lambda) := J_{00}(\Lambda) / J_{00}(\Lambda^p)$.

nodes.name: One-step eigenvector relation
nodes.statement:
Observe that 
 \[\text{pr}_{M(f)} \circ F_m(\Lambda,\lambda,x) \circ \text{pr}_0 (\exp \pi H(\Lambda^p,\lambda^p,x^p)) = \text{pr}_{M(f)}  (\exp \pi H(\Lambda,\lambda,x))
\]
so that
\begin{align*}
\alpha_{1, \Lambda}^*( \eta(\Lambda^p, \lambda^p, x) ) &= \c F(\Lambda) \text{pr}_{M(f)} \left( \frac{\exp \pi H(\Lambda, \lambda, x)}{J_{00}(\Lambda)} \right) \\
&= \c F(\Lambda) \left( \eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x)  + \tilde \omega (\Lambda, \lambda, x) \right),
\end{align*}
where each $\lambda^\gamma$ appearing in $\tilde \omega$ lies in $M(\Gamma) \setminus M_0(\Gamma)$.
conclusions:
\alpha_{1, \Lambda}^*( \eta(\Lambda^p, \lambda^p, x) ) &= \c F(\Lambda) \text{pr}_{M(f)} \left( \frac{\exp \pi H(\Lambda, \lambda, x)}{J_{00}(\Lambda)} \right) \\
&= \c F(\Lambda) \left( \eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x)  + \tilde \omega (\Lambda, \lambda, x) \right),
nodes.statement_short: $\alpha^*_{1,\Lambda}\eta(\Lambda^p,\lambda^p,x)=\mathcal F(\Lambda)(\eta+\tilde\omega)$ with $\tilde\omega$ supported off $M_0(\Gamma)$.

nodes.name: Iterated eigenvector relation (23)
nodes.statement:
Iterating this, if we set
\[
\c F_m(\Lambda) := \prod_{i=0}^{m-1} \c F(\Lambda^{p^i}),
\]
then we have
\begin{equation} \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* \eta(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x) = \c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\Lambda) \left( \eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) + \omega(\Lambda, \lambda, x) \right),
\end{equation}
where each $\lambda^\gamma$ appearing in $\omega$ lies in $M(\Gamma) \setminus M_0(\Gamma)$.
conclusions:
\label{E: first formula}
\alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* \eta(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x) = \c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\Lambda) \left( \eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) + \omega(\Lambda, \lambda, x) \right),
nodes.statement_short: Iterating, $\alpha^*_{ad(\bar t),\Lambda}\eta(\Lambda^{q},\lambda^{q},x)=\mathcal F_{ad(\bar t)}(\Lambda)(\eta+\omega)$.

nodes.name: First formula (23)
nodes.statement: \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* \eta(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x) = \c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\Lambda) \left( \eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) + \omega(\Lambda, \lambda, x) \right),
nodes.label: E: first formula

nodes.name: Coefficients Q_{gamma,u}
nodes.statement:
For notational convenience, set $Q_{\gamma, u} := Q_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda) := J_{\gamma, u}(\Lambda) / J_{0,0}(\Lambda)$ so that
\[
\eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) = 1 + \sum_{\substack{\gamma \in M_0(\Gamma), u \in M_0(f) \\ (\gamma, u) \not= (0, 0)}} Q_{\gamma, u} \tilde \pi^{-w_\Gamma(\gamma) - w(u)} \lambda^{-\gamma}  x^{-u}.
\]

nodes.name: Argument that pr(1 + Upsilon(omega)/Upsilon(eta))^kappa = 1
nodes.statement:
Next, write
\[
\Upsilon(\eta) = 1 + \sum_{\substack{\gamma \in M_0(\Gamma), u \in M_0(f) \\ (\gamma, u) \not= (0, 0)}} Q_{\gamma, u} \tilde \pi^{-w_\Gamma(\gamma)} \lambda^{-\gamma} e_u^*,
\]
and observe that $\Upsilon(\eta)$ and $1 / \Upsilon(\eta)$ are elements of $\c S_0^*(\c W_0(\c K_0))$. For $\kappa \in \bb Z_p$, we compute
\begin{align*}
(\Upsilon(\eta))^\kappa &= \sum_{l=0}^\infty \binom{\kappa}{l}(\sum Q_{\gamma, u} \tilde \pi^{-w_\Gamma(\gamma)} \lambda^{-\gamma} e_u^*)^l \\
&= \sum_{l=0}^\kappa \binom{\kappa}{l} \sum_{\substack{\gamma_1, \ldots, \gamma_l \in M_0(\Gamma) \\ u_1, \ldots, u_l \in M_0(f) \\ (\gamma_j, u_j) \not= (0, 0) \text{ for every j}} } Q_{\gamma_1, u_1} \cdots Q_{\gamma_l, u_l} \tilde \pi^{-w_\Gamma(\gamma_1) - \cdots - w_\Gamma(\gamma_l)} \lambda^{-(\gamma_1 + \cdots + \gamma_l)} e_{u_1}^* \cdots e_{u_l}^* \\
&= \sum_{l = 0}^\infty \binom{\kappa}{l} \sum_{\substack{\gamma_1, \ldots, \gamma_l \in M_0(\Gamma) \\ u_1, \ldots, u_l \in M_0(f) \\ (\gamma_j, u_j) \not= (0, 0) \text{ for every j}} } \widetilde{Q}_{\gamma, u} \cdot \tilde \pi^{-w_\Gamma(\gamma_1 + \cdots + \gamma_l)} \lambda^{-(\gamma_1 + \cdots + \gamma_l)} e_{u_1}^* \cdots e_{u_l}^*
\end{align*}
where
\[
\widetilde{Q}_{\gamma, u} := Q_{\gamma_1, u_1} \cdots Q_{\gamma_l, u_l} \tilde \pi^{-w_\Gamma(\gamma_1) - \cdots - w_\Gamma(\gamma_l) + w_\Gamma(\gamma_1 + \cdots + \gamma_l)}.
\]
Hence, $(\Upsilon(\eta))^\kappa \in \c S^*(\c W_0(\c K_0))$.  As every $\lambda^\gamma$ appearing in $\Upsilon(\omega)$ (from equation (\ref{E: first formula})) satisfies $\gamma \in M(\Gamma) \setminus M_0(\Gamma)$, it follows that the same is true for $( \Upsilon(\omega) / \Upsilon(\eta) )^r$ for any $r \in \bb Z_{\geq 1}$.
nodes.statement_short: Expand $\Upsilon(\eta)^\kappa$ binomially to see it lies in the right space; since $\omega$ is supported off $M_0(\Gamma)$, so are powers of $\Upsilon(\omega)/\Upsilon(\eta)$.

nodes.name: Write Upsilon(eta)
nodes.statement:
Next, write
\[
\Upsilon(\eta) = 1 + \sum_{\substack{\gamma \in M_0(\Gamma), u \in M_0(f) \\ (\gamma, u) \not= (0, 0)}} Q_{\gamma, u} \tilde \pi^{-w_\Gamma(\gamma)} \lambda^{-\gamma} e_u^*,
\]
and observe that $\Upsilon(\eta)$ and $1 / \Upsilon(\eta)$ are elements of $\c S_0^*(\c W_0(\c K_0))$.
nodes.statement_short: Write $\Upsilon(\eta)$; it and its inverse lie in $\mathcal S_0^*(\mathcal W_0(\mathcal K_0))$.

nodes.name: Binomial expansion of Upsilon(eta)^kappa
nodes.statement:
For $\kappa \in \bb Z_p$, we compute
\begin{align*}
(\Upsilon(\eta))^\kappa &= \sum_{l=0}^\infty \binom{\kappa}{l}(\sum Q_{\gamma, u} \tilde \pi^{-w_\Gamma(\gamma)} \lambda^{-\gamma} e_u^*)^l \\
&= \sum_{l=0}^\kappa \binom{\kappa}{l} \sum_{\substack{\gamma_1, \ldots, \gamma_l \in M_0(\Gamma) \\ u_1, \ldots, u_l \in M_0(f) \\ (\gamma_j, u_j) \not= (0, 0) \text{ for every j}} } Q_{\gamma_1, u_1} \cdots Q_{\gamma_l, u_l} \tilde \pi^{-w_\Gamma(\gamma_1) - \cdots - w_\Gamma(\gamma_l)} \lambda^{-(\gamma_1 + \cdots + \gamma_l)} e_{u_1}^* \cdots e_{u_l}^* \\
&= \sum_{l = 0}^\infty \binom{\kappa}{l} \sum_{\substack{\gamma_1, \ldots, \gamma_l \in M_0(\Gamma) \\ u_1, \ldots, u_l \in M_0(f) \\ (\gamma_j, u_j) \not= (0, 0) \text{ for every j}} } \widetilde{Q}_{\gamma, u} \cdot \tilde \pi^{-w_\Gamma(\gamma_1 + \cdots + \gamma_l)} \lambda^{-(\gamma_1 + \cdots + \gamma_l)} e_{u_1}^* \cdots e_{u_l}^*
\end{align*}
where
\[
\widetilde{Q}_{\gamma, u} := Q_{\gamma_1, u_1} \cdots Q_{\gamma_l, u_l} \tilde \pi^{-w_\Gamma(\gamma_1) - \cdots - w_\Gamma(\gamma_l) + w_\Gamma(\gamma_1 + \cdots + \gamma_l)}.
\]
Hence, $(\Upsilon(\eta))^\kappa \in \c S^*(\c W_0(\c K_0))$.
nodes.statement_short: Binomially expand $\Upsilon(\eta)^\kappa$ and see it lies in the space.

nodes.name: Support of omega/eta powers
nodes.statement: As every $\lambda^\gamma$ appearing in $\Upsilon(\omega)$ (from equation (\ref{E: first formula})) satisfies $\gamma \in M(\Gamma) \setminus M_0(\Gamma)$, it follows that the same is true for $( \Upsilon(\omega) / \Upsilon(\eta) )^r$ for any $r \in \bb Z_{\geq 1}$.
nodes.statement_short: Powers of $\Upsilon(\omega)/\Upsilon(\eta)$ stay supported off $M_0(\Gamma)$.

nodes.name: Projection of the omega-correction is trivial
nodes.statement:
Hence,
\[
\text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \left(1 + \frac{\Upsilon(\omega)}{\Upsilon(\eta) } \right)^\kappa  = 1.
\]
conclusions: \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \left(1 + \frac{\Upsilon(\omega)}{\Upsilon(\eta) } \right)^\kappa  = 1.

nodes.name: Proof of the Main Theorem
nodes.statement:
We may now finish the proof of Theorem \ref{T: Main Thm}. For convenience, write $\eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) = 1 + h(\Lambda, \lambda, x)$ so that $\Upsilon(\eta)^\kappa = (1 + \Upsilon(h))^\kappa = \sum_{l=0}^\infty  \binom{\kappa}{l} \Upsilon(h)^l$. Observe that 
\begin{align*}
\beta_{\kappa, \bar t, \Lambda}^* \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda, x))^\kappa &= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \circ [\alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^*]_\kappa \circ \Phi_\lambda^{a d(\bar t)} \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda, x))^\kappa \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \circ [\alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^*]_\kappa \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x))^\kappa \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \circ [\alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^*]_\kappa  \sum_{l=0}^\infty \binom{\kappa}{l} \Upsilon \left( h(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x)  \right)^l \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \sum_{l=0}^\infty \binom{\kappa}{l} \left(\Upsilon \circ \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* \cdot 1 \right)^{\kappa - l} \left(\Upsilon \circ  \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* h(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x) \right)^l \qquad \text{by definition of $ [\alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^*]_\kappa$} \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \> \left( \Upsilon \circ  \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* \cdot 1 + \Upsilon \circ  \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* h(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x) \right)^\kappa \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \>  \left( \Upsilon \circ  \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* \eta(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x) \right)^\kappa \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \>  \c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\Lambda)^\kappa \left( \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) + \Upsilon(\omega(\Lambda, \lambda, x)  \right)^\kappa \qquad \text{by } (\ref{E: first formula}) \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \>  \c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\Lambda)^\kappa \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x))^\kappa \left( 1 + \frac{\Upsilon(\omega(\Lambda, \lambda, x))}{\Upsilon( \eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x))}  \right)^\kappa \\
&= \c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\Lambda)^\kappa \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x))^\kappa.
\end{align*}
Finally, we may specialize this equality taking  $\Lambda$ at the Teichm\"uller unit coefficients of $\hat G(\hat t, \lambda, x)$:
\[
\Lambda_u = \hat t_u \qquad \text{and} \qquad \Lambda_{\gamma, v} = \hat A(\gamma, v) \qquad \text{for all $u$ and $\gamma, v$ in the support of $H$},
\] 
and setting
\[
\eta_{\text{sp}}(\lambda, x) := \left( \eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) \text{ specialized at $\Lambda_u = \hat t_u$ and $\Lambda_{\gamma, v} = \hat A(\gamma, v)$} \right),
\]
then we see that
\begin{equation} \beta_{\kappa, \bar t}^* \Upsilon(\eta_{\text{sp}}(\lambda, x))^\kappa = \c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\hat t)^\kappa \Upsilon(\eta_{\text{sp}}(\lambda, x))^\kappa 
\end{equation}
This demonstrates that $\c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\hat t)^\kappa$ is the unique unit root of $L^{(0)}(\kappa, \bar t, T)^{(-1)^{s+1}}$ by (\ref{E: L0  and dual}), which, together with Theorem \ref{T: unique unit}, completes the proof of Theorem \ref{T: Main Thm}.
nodes.statement_short: Show $\Upsilon(\eta)^\kappa$ is an eigenvector of $\beta^*_{\kappa,\bar t,\Lambda}$ with eigenvalue $\mathcal F_{ad(\bar t)}(\Lambda)^\kappa$ and specialize $\Lambda$ at Teichm\"uller lifts. Theorem 4.5 then identifies it as the unit root of $L^{(0)}$, and Theorem 3.1 finishes.

nodes.name: Write eta = 1 + h
nodes.statement: We may now finish the proof of Theorem \ref{T: Main Thm}. For convenience, write $\eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) = 1 + h(\Lambda, \lambda, x)$ so that $\Upsilon(\eta)^\kappa = (1 + \Upsilon(h))^\kappa = \sum_{l=0}^\infty  \binom{\kappa}{l} \Upsilon(h)^l$.
nodes.statement_short: Write $\eta=1+h$ and expand $\Upsilon(\eta)^\kappa$ binomially.

nodes.name: Eigenvector computation
nodes.statement:
Observe that 
\begin{align*}
\beta_{\kappa, \bar t, \Lambda}^* \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda, x))^\kappa &= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \circ [\alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^*]_\kappa \circ \Phi_\lambda^{a d(\bar t)} \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda, x))^\kappa \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \circ [\alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^*]_\kappa \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x))^\kappa \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \circ [\alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^*]_\kappa  \sum_{l=0}^\infty \binom{\kappa}{l} \Upsilon \left( h(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x)  \right)^l \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \sum_{l=0}^\infty \binom{\kappa}{l} \left(\Upsilon \circ \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* \cdot 1 \right)^{\kappa - l} \left(\Upsilon \circ  \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* h(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x) \right)^l \qquad \text{by definition of $ [\alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^*]_\kappa$} \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \> \left( \Upsilon \circ  \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* \cdot 1 + \Upsilon \circ  \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* h(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x) \right)^\kappa \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \>  \left( \Upsilon \circ  \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* \eta(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x) \right)^\kappa \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \>  \c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\Lambda)^\kappa \left( \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) + \Upsilon(\omega(\Lambda, \lambda, x)  \right)^\kappa \qquad \text{by } (\ref{E: first formula}) \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \>  \c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\Lambda)^\kappa \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x))^\kappa \left( 1 + \frac{\Upsilon(\omega(\Lambda, \lambda, x))}{\Upsilon( \eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x))}  \right)^\kappa \\
&= \c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\Lambda)^\kappa \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x))^\kappa.
\end{align*}
nodes.statement_short: Chain of identities shows $\beta^*_{\kappa,\bar t,\Lambda}\Upsilon(\eta)^\kappa=\mathcal F_{ad(\bar t)}(\Lambda)^\kappa\Upsilon(\eta)^\kappa$.

nodes.name: Specialize Lambda
nodes.statement:
Finally, we may specialize this equality taking  $\Lambda$ at the Teichm\"uller unit coefficients of $\hat G(\hat t, \lambda, x)$:
\[
\Lambda_u = \hat t_u \qquad \text{and} \qquad \Lambda_{\gamma, v} = \hat A(\gamma, v) \qquad \text{for all $u$ and $\gamma, v$ in the support of $H$},
\] 
and setting
\[
\eta_{\text{sp}}(\lambda, x) := \left( \eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) \text{ specialized at $\Lambda_u = \hat t_u$ and $\Lambda_{\gamma, v} = \hat A(\gamma, v)$} \right),
\]
then we see that
\begin{equation} \beta_{\kappa, \bar t}^* \Upsilon(\eta_{\text{sp}}(\lambda, x))^\kappa = \c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\hat t)^\kappa \Upsilon(\eta_{\text{sp}}(\lambda, x))^\kappa 
\end{equation}
nodes.statement_short: Specialize $\Lambda$ at Teichm\"uller lifts to get (24).

nodes.name: Conclude unit root
nodes.statement: This demonstrates that $\c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\hat t)^\kappa$ is the unique unit root of $L^{(0)}(\kappa, \bar t, T)^{(-1)^{s+1}}$ by (\ref{E: L0  and dual}), which, together with Theorem \ref{T: unique unit}, completes the proof of Theorem \ref{T: Main Thm}.
nodes.statement_short: By (20) and Theorem 3.1, this is the unique unit root.

nodes.name: Eigenvalue equation (24)
nodes.statement: \beta_{\kappa, \bar t}^* \Upsilon(\eta_{\text{sp}}(\lambda, x))^\kappa = \c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\hat t)^\kappa \Upsilon(\eta_{\text{sp}}(\lambda, x))^\kappa
nodes.label: E: unit root dual

nodes.name: Lifting G-hat with variable t
nodes.statement: Let  $\hat A(\gamma, v)$ be the Teichm\"uller lift in $\bb Q_q$ for each $(\gamma, v) \in Supp(P)$, and denote the lifting of $G$ by $\hat G(t, \lambda, x) := \hat f(t, x) + \hat P(\lambda, x) = \sum t_u x^u + \sum \hat A(\gamma, v) \lambda^\gamma x^v \in \bb Q_q[x_1^\pm, \ldots, x_n^\pm, \lambda_1^\pm, \ldots, \lambda_s^\pm, \{ t_u \}_{u \in Supp(f)}]$.

nodes.name: Dual monomials e_u^*
nodes.statement: Monomials in $\c S_0^*(\c O_0)$ have the form $e_{\b u}^* := e_{u_1}^* e_{u_2}^* \cdots e_{u_r}^*$, where $u_1, \ldots, u_r \in M(f) \setminus \{0\}$ for $r > 0$, and $e_0^* := 1$ when $r = 0$.
